race.comment: ICY YOU (11) is a gelding by Pinatubo on debut for the Busuttin & Young stable. He's had plenty of jumpouts and shown ability, respecting in a winnable race. DON'T DOUBT TIGGA (2) should be ready to show something third up on firmer footing while ASKMUMASKDAD (1) is a chance on the run here two back. DIAMOND STORM (13) should be right at his peak third up and is going better than it appears on paper.
